SASBDB entry SASDNK7  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDNK7/)

Publication: Small-angle X-ray scattering data of a guanine-rich DNA derived from the promoter region of c-MYC gene in solution
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dib.2022.108285

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDNK7/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
